deeper.title: What the price assumes
deeper.text: The price assumes about 13% a year growth in free cash flow for 10 years, then 3% (discount rate 10.0% = 10-year Treasury 5.0% + 5%; base: last 12 months of free cash flow). For comparison, sales grew 12% last year; 4%/yr over 3 years — roughly in line with its recent growth.

deeper.title: Return on capital
deeper.text: 22% (3 years ago 47%, falling) — each $100 invested in the business (debt + equity, net of cash) earns about $22 a year after tax; return on shareholders' equity 26% (3 years ago 28%).

deeper.title: Signed future revenue
deeper.text: Signed but not yet delivered (remaining performance obligations): $46.7B, up 7% from a year ago — about 0.7× the last 12 months of sales; customer prepayments not yet earned (deferred revenue): $29.8B, up 3% from a year ago.

deeper.title: Earnings-quality red flags
flags: Inventory up 80% vs quarterly sales up 18% (days of inventory 53 → 84). Products may be building up unsold — a warning sign in chip cycles.

deeper.title: Multi-year view
deeper.text: Sales grew 4%/yr over 3 years and 5%/yr over 5 years; operating margin today 24% vs a 5-year range of 19–27% (median 25%): in the middle of a fairly narrow range.
deeper.margin_position: in the middle of a fairly narrow range

deeper.title: Cash returned to shareholders
deeper.text: Returned $12.7B to shareholders over the last 12 months ($6.1B buybacks + $6.6B dividends) = 3.1% of the company's market value. Share count down 0.5% from a year ago (about flat).

deeper.title: Analyst estimates
deeper.text: Next year's earnings-per-share estimate $5.77, up 3% in 90 days (up 2% in the last 30); 4 analysts raised, 0 cut in 30 days. This year's earnings-per-share estimate $5.51, up 7% in 90 days (up 7% in the last 30); 1 analyst raised, 1 cut in 30 days. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

deeper.title: Where sales come from
deeper.text: By segment, latest year vs a year earlier: Americas 60% of sales, up 12%; EMEA 26% of sales, up 12%; APJC 14% of sales, up 9%. Source: 10-K XBRL.

tiles.title: Earnings per share
tiles.sub: +40% vs a year ago · $3.33 over 12 months (GAAP)
tiles.read: Profit per share grew 40% vs sales 18% (latest quarter vs a year earlier): profits are outgrowing sales, so margins are widening.
tiles.explain: EPS = profit divided by the number of shares. The quarterly figures are the 'adjusted' EPS analysts track (Yahoo); the 12-month figure is the official GAAP number from SEC filings.

tiles.title: Earnings vs forecasts
tiles.sub: last 8 reports · bars = EPS beat (+) or miss (−) vs the average forecast
tiles.read: Beat forecasts 8 quarters running by about 4%: beating is now expected, so a small beat may not lift the stock.
tiles.explain: A 'beat' means reported EPS came in above the average analyst forecast. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

tiles.title: Sales growth
tiles.sub: latest quarter +18% vs a year earlier · 12-month sales $63.3B
tiles.read: Latest quarter: sales up 18% vs a year earlier and speeding up (from 10% two quarters ago): demand is strengthening.
tiles.explain: Headline: sales over the last 12 months vs the 12 months before. Bars: each quarter's sales vs the same quarter a year earlier.

tiles.title: Profit margins
tiles.read: Each $100 of sales leaves $24 of operating profit, up from $21 a year ago: profitability is improving.
tiles.explain: Operating margin = operating profit ÷ sales. Gross margin = what's left after the direct cost of the product.

tiles.title: Free cash flow
tiles.read: It turned 96% of its reported profit into spare cash: the profits are real money, not just accounting.
tiles.explain: Free cash flow = cash from operations minus spending on equipment and buildings: money the company could return or reinvest.

tiles.title: Price vs profits (P/E)
tiles.read: You pay 30× last year's profit (higher than 89% of the last 5 years); only 18× next year's forecast, so the market expects profits to jump.
tiles.explain: P/E = share price ÷ earnings per share. Forward P/E uses next year's forecast earnings.

tiles.title: Company outlook
tiles.read: No numeric outlook was found in the latest earnings release, so the next report carries more surprise risk.
tiles.explain: Guidance = what management says it expects for the next quarter or year, from its 8-K earnings release.

tiles.title: Forecast changes
